confirmed.claim: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available for building and running AI agents at scale.
confirmed.quote: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available. AgentCore is an agentic platform to build, deploy and operate AI agents securely at scale, using any framework and any foundation model. AgentCore adds support for VPC, AWS PrivateLink and AWS CloudFormation. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is available in nine AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Europe (Frankfurt) and Europe (Ireland).

confirmed.claim: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now generally available as a serverless distributed SQL database with active-active high availability.
confirmed.quote: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now generally available. Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database with virtually unlimited scale, active-active high availability, PostgreSQL compatibility and no infrastructure to manage.
